_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Naval Aviation Cyber Analysis of Commercial Off-The-Shelf and Non-Developmental Items
summary: This DID specifies the format and content for an analysis demonstrating that COTS and non-developmental items are properly configured, integrated, controlled, and that their unique cyber risks are mitigated.
use_relationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content for the analysis that demonstrates commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and non-developmental items (NDI) are appropriately configured, integrated, software / hardware / firmware is controlled, and any unique risks they pose are mitigated as tailored in the system spec.
This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the contract Statement of Work (SOW).
This DID supersedes DI-MGMT-82145.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Referenced Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The analysis shall contain the following:

children.title: Provide a description of the COTS/NDI item and the functions/tasks the item will perform with in the system.
The as-built configuration of the COTS/NDI item as delivered prior to incorporation into the system.
children.content: This shall include hardware, software, and firmware. Identified cyber risks prior to modification shall also be included.

children.title: Provide information on how the COTS/NDI item has been modified and/or configured to meet the needs of the system.
children.content: Include how these modifications/configuration updates address cyber risks identified in the previous paragraph.

children.title: Include a recommended future support concept of the COTS/NDI based on modification(s) made.
Include a list and description of unmitigated cyber risks that modifications/configuration updates do not address.
